decisionSource: Current direct teacher interview; interpretation rules only.

bookNotation.seriesMeaning: Textbook series/volume; never a unit or test round.

unitNotation.ambiguousHistoricalLabel: Preserve the literal and ask for an explicit teacher/source binding; do not strip prefixes or infer rounds from suffixes.

correctionScope: Apply each correction only to the identified student/book/activity/period. Retain earlier source observation and the overriding teacher decision separately.

parentWording.sharedDeadline: Display each known deadline once above its group; render undated entries before dated groups so no date is implied for an undated entry.
parentWording.sharedBook: Display the exact edition label once above consecutive entries for that book; structured book and unit references remain unchanged.
parentWording.wholeMinorUnits: Whole minor units in the same student and exact edition may share a line only when activity and deadline match; list every unit code. Keep section-scoped and chapter-assessment entries individually bound.
parentWording.originalClinicWording: The parent-facing text may omit the word 원본 before 오답클리닉 when no distinct activity becomes ambiguous; preserve the track in structured evidence.

sourceMeaning: Track vocabulary does not identify or change a textbook publisher/series.
Class practice, assigned homework, excluded homework, solving, grading and correction are separate facts.
Reported activity labels or default rounds do not establish physical print counts.
An unscheduled student is not an absent student.
Source IDs require fresh qualified native observation; notation is not a native identity join.

homeworkAssessment.numericCompletionToNativeGrade: Requires an attributed teacher decision for the specific case; no inferred global conversion table.
homeworkAssessment.parentMemo: Do not automatically repeat internal grade-conversion details in the parent-facing memo.
